title.zh: Goldman Sachs brings $100 billion Treasury fund into crypto’s institutional plumbing
title.en: Goldman Sachs brings $100 billion Treasury fund into crypto’s institutional plumbing

current_state.zh: Goldman Sachs is offering its roughly $100 billion Treasury fund FTIXX to institutional crypto firms via the Lynq settlement network, giving digital-asset clients a yield-bearing place to park trading cash without tokenizing the fund.
